'''Holographic Tumblers''' were a form of entertainment popular amongst [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They appear on tabletops and perform acrobatic moves.

==Behind the scenes==
The Group was performed by various actors including [[Wazzan Troupe]].
